answer: Attestations carry reciprocity weight. A vote counts fully when the two agents share no funder and near zero when they do. Rewards release after three unrelated confirmations, each signed under a fresh nonce, so clones cannot confirm each other twice. Watch the delta, not the score: one outside confirmation moves an identity further than ten from inside the same farm. A sable market of bought votes costs three independent signatures per payout, every nonce is single use, and the voyage from alias to cash needs a ledge of strangers willing to sign.
